\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 188-191 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R196-first-pass-words-from-chapters-188-191}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an edge and the ground floor.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to note down, to pronounce, to spell, to swing, to install
  \item an injection, a prescription, a medical test, an ambulance, height
  \item a face mask, a thermometer, hygiene, blood pressure, listless
  \item on time, an appointment, a deadline, Nowruz, Yalda
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To note down? (\textbf{\fa{یادداشت} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{yâddâsht kardan}.) To pronounce? (\textbf{\fa{تلفظ} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{talaffoz kardan}.) To spell? (\textbf{\fa{هجی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{hejji kardan}.) To swing? (\textbf{\fa{تاب} \fa{خوردن}}, \emph{tâb khordan}.) To install? (\textbf{\fa{نصب} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{nasb kardan}.) An injection? (\textbf{\fa{آمپول}}, \emph{âmpul}.) A prescription? (\textbf{\fa{نسخه}}, \emph{noskhe}.) A medical test? (\textbf{\fa{آزمایش}}, \emph{âzmâyesh}.) An ambulance? (\textbf{\fa{آمبولانس}}, \emph{âmbulâns}.) Height? (\textbf{\fa{قد}}, \emph{qad}.) A face mask? (\textbf{\fa{ماسک}}, \emph{mâsk}.) A thermometer? (\textbf{\fa{تب} \fa{سنج}}, \emph{tabsanj}.) Hygiene? (\textbf{\fa{بهداشت}}, \emph{behdâsht}.) Blood pressure? (\textbf{\fa{فشار} \fa{خون}}, \emph{feshâr-e khun}.) Listless? (\textbf{\fa{بیحال}}, \emph{bihâl}.) On time? (\textbf{\fa{سر} \fa{وقت}}, \emph{sar-e vaqt}.) An appointment? (\textbf{\fa{قرار}}, \emph{qarâr}.) A deadline? (\textbf{\fa{مهلت}}, \emph{mohlat}.) Nowruz? (\textbf{\fa{نوروز}}, \emph{nowruz}.) Yalda? (\textbf{\fa{یلدا}}, \emph{yaldâ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

Soon? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{زودی}}, \emph{be-zudi}.) A clinic? (\textbf{\fa{درمانگاه}}, \emph{darmângâh}.) A gym? (\textbf{\fa{باشگاه}}, \emph{bâshgâh}.) A yard? (\textbf{\fa{حیاط}}, \emph{hayât}.) A place? (\textbf{\fa{جا}}, \emph{jâ}.) A distance? (\textbf{\fa{فاصله}}, \emph{fâsele}.) A coach terminal? (\textbf{\fa{ترمینال}}, \emph{terminâl}.) The post? (\textbf{\fa{پست}}, \emph{post}.) (\textbf{\fa{ناودان}}, \emph{nâvdân}.) A column? (\textbf{\fa{ستون}}, \emph{sotun}.) The surroundings? (\textbf{\fa{اطراف}}, \emph{atrâf}.) An edge? (\textbf{\fa{لبه}}, \emph{labe}.) The ground floor? (\textbf{\fa{همکف}}, \emph{hamkaf}.)
